add-png-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add PNG Image to Specific PDF Page using PdfFileMend
add-png-image-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to bind an existing PDF with PdfFileMend, insert a PNG image onto page two at defined coordinates, and save the modified document.

replace-jpeg-with-bmp-first-page.title: Replace JPEG with High‑Resolution BMP on First PDF Page
replace-jpeg-with-bmp-first-page.description: Demonstrates how to replace the first image on page one of a PDF with a higher‑resolution BMP using Aspose.Pdf's PdfContentEditor.

overlay-semi-transparent-gif-on-pdf.title: Overlay Semi-Transparent GIF on PDF
overlay-semi-transparent-gif-on-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to place a semi‑transparent GIF over an existing PNG in a PDF using CompositingParameters with the PdfFileMend facade.

add-wrapped-footer-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Word‑by‑Word Wrapped Footer to PDF Pages
add-wrapped-footer-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf Facade API to add a formatted footer that wraps word‑by‑word across the page width on every PDF page.

add-promotional-text-to-specific-pdf-pag.title: Add Promotional Text to Specific PDF Pages
add-promotional-text-to-specific-pdf-pag.description: Shows how to insert the same promotional message on pages 3, 5, and 7 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Facade API with AddStamp.

add-multi-line-text-block-page-3.title: Add Multi‑Line Text Block with Custom Line Spacing to Page 3
add-multi-line-text-block-page-3.description: Demonstrates how to use the PdfFileMend facade to bind an existing PDF, create a multi‑line TextParagraph with custom line spacing, and place it at the left margin of the third page.

add-image-and-text-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Image and Semi‑Transparent Text Watermark to PDF
add-image-and-text-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to combine an image and semi‑transparent text into a single stamp and apply it as a watermark on all pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-png-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Add Background PNG to All PDF Pages
add-background-png-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, retrieve each page's dimensions, and overlay a PNG image as a background on every page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-header-image-to-pdf-documents.title: Add Header Image to PDF Documents
add-header-image-to-pdf-documents.description: Shows how to insert a header image into one or more PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileStamp in a console application.

batch-add-company-logo-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Company Logo to PDFs
batch-add-company-logo-to-pdfs.description: Shows how to process all PDF files in a folder and overlay a PNG company logo at the top‑right corner of each page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

insert-png-signature-image-on-every-pdf-.title: Insert PNG Signature Image on Every PDF Page
insert-png-signature-image-on-every-pdf-.description: Demonstrates how to use PdfFileMend to add a PNG signature image to the bottom‑left corner of each page in a PDF and save the modified document.

add-tiff-image-to-last-page-pdf.title: Add TIFF Image to Last Page of PDF using PdfFileMend
add-tiff-image-to-last-page-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileMend to embed a TIFF image onto the final page of an existing PDF without altering the original content.

add-image-to-each-pdf-page-dynamic-posit.title: Add Image to Each PDF Page with Dynamic Positioning
add-image-to-each-pdf-page-dynamic-posit.description: Loads a PDF, calculates each page's dimensions, and places a PNG image in the bottom‑right corner of every page using the PdfFileMend facade.

add-image-to-pdf-with-format-validation.title: Add Image to PDF with Format Validation
add-image-to-pdf-with-format-validation.description: Demonstrates how to validate an image's file format and then add the image to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-image-to-pdf-using-pdffilemend.title: Add Image to PDF Using PdfFileMend with Try‑Finally
add-image-to-pdf-using-pdffilemend.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, insert an image on a page, save the result, and guarantee that PdfFileMend is closed using a try‑finally block.

add-images-to-pdf-with-error-handling.title: Add Images to PDF with Error Handling
add-images-to-pdf-with-error-handling.description: Demonstrates how to insert multiple images into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileMend facade while handling missing files and AddImage failures gracefully.

add-image-and-text-to-pdf-with-audit-log.title: Add Image and Text to PDF with Audit Logging
add-image-and-text-to-pdf-with-audit-log.description: Loads a PDF, adds an image and a formatted text watermark to page 1, logs each AddImage and AddText operation with timestamp, page number and file name, then saves the modified document.

configure-word-wrapping-bywords-add-long.title: Configure Word Wrapping ByWords and Add Long Text to PDF
configure-word-wrapping-bywords-add-long.description: The example shows how to enable word wrapping on a PDF using PdfFileMend, set the wrap mode to ByWords, and add a long paragraph that automatically wraps within the defined width.

add-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Image to Specific PDF Page
add-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades to insert an image onto a chosen page of a PDF at given rectangle coordinates via a reusable helper method.

async-add-image-to-pdf.title: Asynchronously Add Image to PDF Using PdfFileMend
async-add-image-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to modify a PDF on a background thread by adding an image to the first page with Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileMend, wrapped in Task.Run for non‑blocking execution.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-png.title: Extract Images from PDF to PNG using PdfExtractor
extract-images-from-pdf-to-png.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF document and save each as an individual PNG file.

extract-images-from-pdf-pages.title: Extract Images from Specific PDF Pages
extract-images-from-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from pages 2‑5 of a PDF and save them as PNG files in a temporary directory.

batch-extract-images-from-pdfs.title: Batch Extract Images from PDFs with Page and Index Naming
batch-extract-images-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to process multiple PDF files, extract images from each page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and save them with filenames that contain the original PDF name, page number, and image index.

remove-image-from-pdf-page.title: Remove Image from Specific PDF Page
remove-image-from-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to delete a particular image identified by its object ID from page four of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfContentEditor.

remove-all-images-from-pdf.title: Remove All Images from PDF
remove-all-images-from-pdf.description: Shows how to delete every image in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfContentEditor facade and save the modified document to a new file.

replace-low-res-images-with-high-res-png.title: Replace Low-Resolution Images with High-Resolution PNGs in PDF
replace-low-res-images-with-high-res-png.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through each page of a PDF, detect embedded images, and replace low‑resolution images with corresponding high‑resolution PNG files using Aspose.Pdf facades.

add-text-at-coordinates-verify-position.title: Add Text at Specific Coordinates and Verify Position
add-text-at-coordinates-verify-position.description: Creates a blank PDF, adds a text fragment at defined X/Y coordinates using TextBuilder, saves and reloads the file, then uses TextFragmentAbsorber to confirm the text appears at the expected position.

add-image-verify-pdf-byte-size.title: Add Image to PDF and Verify Byte Size Increase
add-image-verify-pdf-byte-size.description: Creates a minimal PDF, binds it with PdfFileMend, adds a PNG image, saves the modified document, and asserts that the resulting PDF byte size is larger than the original.
